STREET CLOSURE CONFIRMED FOR ‘99 SANTA CRUZ INDUSTRIAL HEMP EXPO

Expo Endorses 3 "Official Products"

February 10, 1999

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

STREET CLOSURE CONFIRMED FOR ‘99 SANTA CRUZ INDUSTRIAL HEMP EXPO

Expo Endorses 3 "Official Products"

The Santa Cruz Industrial Hemp Expo, slated for Saturday and Sunday, March 20 and 21 at the Civic Auditorium in Santa Cruz, California has a street closure on Church Street in front of the Civic for 4 days, Friday, March 19 through Monday, March 21, approved by the Santa Cruz City Council on January 26, 1999. A 30’ x 30’ tent (with walls, lighting, etc.) supplied by Michael S. Hensley Company of South San Francisco will be open show days.

Henflings of Ben Lomond, CA will be catering hemp alcohol products from the tent, which will include Humbolt Brewing Company’s Hemp Ale and Nirvana Homebrew’s Hemp-N-Wine. True Nature Foods of Boulder Creek CA, which has the hot hemp foods concession inside the Civic will be serving hot hemp foods from the tent also.

The Expo has endorsed 3 products for the ‘99 show. Official Soft Drink:

"Willies Hemp Soda." Official Lollipop: "Hemppop" from Cannabis Candy Company. Official Menstrual Pad: "Rad Pads" hemp/organic cotton menstrual pads from The Garage.

Vendor booth space "sold out" mid-January. A complete vendor listing will be posted on

Over 50 booths, live music, a hemp fashion show, a hemp house, hemp foods and beverages, educational and historical exhibits, videos, speakers and panel discussions are featured. Attendance of 6000 for the two-day event is expected. Admission is $5 per day.

For more information call the Hemp Expo’s publicity voicemail at (831) 425-3003, or visit on the web at www.cruzexpo.com .
